description: We are Team FasalAI, passionate about combining AI, data science, and space technology to solve agricultural challenges. FasalAI leverages satellite imagery, environmental data, machine learning, and market intelligence to empower farmers with actionable insights. We aim to harness NASA Earth observation data to enable smarter farming, improve crop decisions, and build climate-resilient agriculture.
summary:
FasalAI is an integrated agricultural intelligence platform designed to empower farmers with data-driven decisions. It combines satellite-based farm monitoring, environmental and weather insights, AI-powered crop recommendations, plant disease detection, mandi price tracking, profit estimation, and an intelligent farming assistant.

By leveraging Earth observation data, environmental indicators, and machine learning, FasalAI aims to transform complex agricultural data into actionable insights. It addresses challenges such as unpredictable weather, inefficient resource utilisation, crop losses, and market uncertainty by bringing essential farming intelligence together in one platform.

Our goal is to explore the potential of NASA Earth observation resources in improving agricultural monitoring, strengthening climate resilience, and making precision agriculture more accessible, practical, and affordable for farmers.
details:
FasalAI is an AI-powered agricultural intelligence platform that helps farmers make informed decisions through satellite data, environmental monitoring, machine learning, and market intelligence.

How it works: FasalAI integrates six major tools: Pulse monitors plot-level soil, water, and air conditions using NASA POWER and weather data; Picks recommends crops based on soil and climate; Clinic identifies plant diseases using a multi-tier AI detection system; Sage provides multilingual voice and text-based farming assistance; Bazaar tracks live mandi prices and government MSP; and the Profit Simulator estimates cultivation costs, yields, and potential returns.

Benefits and Impact: The platform aims to reduce crop losses, improve resource utilisation, support better financial planning, and make agricultural intelligence accessible to small-scale farmers. It supports 109 languages, offline disease detection after initial loading, and low-end smartphones. Leaf images are processed on-device to protect farmer privacy.

Technology Stack: We used HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, WebAssembly, Three.js, ConvNeXt-Tiny with CBAM attention, Roboflow, Hugging Face, Groq AI, Firebase, Open-Meteo, NASA POWER, and AGMARKNET APIs. The application is deployed using Railway.

Creativity and Design Considerations: FasalAI combines multiple independent agricultural tools into one accessible platform. We prioritised affordability, multilingual accessibility, privacy, offline functionality, reliability, and usability in real farming conditions rather than designing solely for demonstrations.
